item.title: Rhapsodic Holiday
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Confiture Soft
  • 発売日: 2018-06-29
  • スコア: 7.13/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ラプソディックホリデイ
  • 英語名: Rhapsodic Holiday

别名

  • ラプホリ

あらすじ

Asuma is an amnesiac who was guided by the talking owl Poritan to the town of Hisuigaoka, which was rife with phantom thieves. After many twists and turns, he ended up joining a group of phantom thieves who were normal students by day, but operated during the night.

One day, the school principal Uta, who was also one of their clients, asked them to steal the emotional energy (FCP – Fragment Component Partes) which was being used for evil deeds. He had the feeling that excitement lies ahead in his future, but also felt a tinge of nostalgia.

item.title: Amanatsu Adolescence
item.description:

  • ブランド: Confiture Soft
  • 発売日: 2017-03-24
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (72 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 甘夏アドゥレセンス
  • 英語名: Amanatsu Adolescence

别名

  • Amadore

あらすじ

At Kazamitou Gakuen, students are free to do as they choose and the light music club which Akira is part of is actually the most ‘free’ rock band! Following the motto of enjoying everything in the world, he partook in the club activities as a bass player with guitarist Ryou and vocalist Natsu. That was until the club was disbanded after setting the auditorium on fire with a flame-throwing guitar.
